# Adrian Treleaven

- **Age:** presumed 30 to 35  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** writer  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian Treleaven is characterized by a tall, broad-shouldered frame and dense brown hair. His facial features include a sharp nose and chin, paired with expansive, luminous dark-gray eyes. Additionally, he exhibits a distinct pallor, with a face showing the clear effects of spending the previous night without sleep.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P1](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0001)_

## History

Adrian Treleaven arrived in the area and took up lodging at the Vane house, where he was immediately captivated by [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's beauty. After being introduced to Captain Saul, who recognized him as the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md), Adrian agreed to write Saul's life story and spent the summer finishing the manuscript. Although he confessed a secret love for [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) when he initially had to leave, he later returned to visit while [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) was staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Adrian and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) declared their love for one another in the garden, receiving a heartfelt blessing from Captain Saul before [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) passed away.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), +22 more_

## Quotes

> "The soul will be provided by you and the body by me. Oh, Captain Saul, a renowned book will be authored by the two of us. And our labor will commence immediately."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)

> "however, it is essentially finished. The final line was composed by me earlier today. Should I manage to locate a publisher, its release will likely occur during the upcoming summer or autumn."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P19](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0019)

> "He has to experience solitude frequently, however. This evening, he resembled a prophet somewhat—his words sounded like those of a person granted a special message. In any case, I need to depart now as well."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P26](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0026)

> "Yes,—he is lacking in his intellect, or some such thing, is he not? However, she mentioned nothing concerning Mrs. Vane, so I assumed she would be the typical bustling rural homemaker who accommodates guests to make a decent living."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P30](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0030)

> "Oh, I will not pay attention to him. I do not think I will spend much time inside the dwelling anyway, save to eat. Even so, what a pity the whole situation is! She must have a difficult existence."
>
> — Adrian Treleaven — [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P32](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0032)

### [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--lorna-vane.md)

Adrian Treleaven is romantically involved with [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), having been smitten by her beauty when [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) first brought him to lodge at the Vane house. Though he initially agonized over his secret love for her and believed he would have to leave without acting on his feelings, Adrian later returned to declare his love for [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) in the garden, receiving a heartfelt blessing on their future.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +16 more_

- Romantically involved with — cared for him in the past  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P18](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027), +1 more</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--nell-harcourt.md)

Adrian Treleaven and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a warm, empathetic friendship. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) initially introduced him to the local area and lodging, and Adrian later confided in her about his secret, agonizing feelings for [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) offered a listening ear and acted as a supportive confidante, keeping him updated and reassuring [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) of Adrian's loving intentions upon his return.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +10 more_

- Friend of — good companions  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P19](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0019)</sub>

### [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--uncle-saul.md)

Adrian Treleaven and Captain Saul formed a close bond after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduced them at [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point), where [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) recognized Adrian as the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md). Adrian agreed to write Saul's life story incorporating his seafaring past and the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), spending a summer at the lighthouse drafting the manuscript and later corresponding with [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) about its publication.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), +14 more_

- Friend of — corresponds with him about his book  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005)</sub>

### [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--winifred-tolley.md)

Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) acts as a friendly acquaintance to Adrian Treleaven, initially dropping him off at Nell's house before he moved to his lodgings. Although she tends to penalize his grandiloquent speech and interrupt somber moments with her pragmatic comments, she likes Adrian and approves of his visits.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +9 more_
